lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular lattice of high-luminance circular blobs. Anterior blobs are smaller and more densely clustered near the branchial region, while posterior blobs are larger with increased inter-blob pixel distance along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature along the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and lower-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs bounded within the dorsal fin's silhouette, primarily localized in the lower-anterior quadrant of the fin area.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, dark, elongated silhouettes (commensal remoras) attached to the ventral surface and the posterior margin of the pectoral fin; a large circular watermark is present in the upper-right quadrant of the image.
